title: taraxacum officinale subsp. alpinum
intro: Taraxacum officinale subsp. alpinum, commonly known as Alpine Dandelion, is a subspecies of the dandelion plant that is native to mountainous regions. This plant is valued for its rich nutritional profile and medicinal properties, offering various health benefits including its ability to support digestion, boost immunity, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Dandelion include anti-inflammatory, anti-diabetic, and hepatoprotective effects, making it a valuable remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Dandelion include taraxasterol, taraxinic acid, and inulin, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
